headline: Macro favors Capital (Labor Share 93.7, Profits/Wages +7.5%); Equities show 3M pullback in AI hardware (-23.91%) vs. IT/Staffing bounce (-9.42%)

bullets.title: Labor Share Compression
bullets.text: BLS Nonfarm Labor Share stands at 93.73 (-0.67% QoQ, -1.60% YoY), remaining structurally below the 2017=100 baseline.
bullets.reason: Real output growth is accruing to capital owners faster than compensation: nonfarm payrolls sit at 159.3M with average weekly hours capped at 34.4h and hourly earnings at $38.00/hr.

bullets.title: Profits Outpacing Wages
bullets.text: Corporate Profits-to-Wage-Bill ratio hit 0.404 (+7.50% QoQ, +22.00% YoY).
bullets.reason: BEA Corporate Profits expanded to $4,279.9B SAAR (+8.40% QoQ, +26.61% YoY) while the annualized private wage bill grew only +0.47% MoM (+4.30% YoY) to $10,827.8B.

bullets.title: Watchlist Spread Drivers
bullets.text: 3M Watchlist Spread is -14.50pp (Capital Enablers -23.91% vs. Labor-Heavy -9.42%).
bullets.reason: Short-term multiple compression hit AI hardware/power names (SMCI (-41.9%), NVDA (-41.5%), VRT (-36.5%)), while oversold IT outsourcers & staffing rebounded (EPAM (+38.9%), INFY (+0.8%), CTSH (-5.7%)). Over 1Y, hardware/grid winners (ANET (+40.2%), PWR (+30.2%), GEV (+25.6%)) still anchor the capex cycle.

bullets.title: AI & Power Capex Catalyst
bullets.text: "Securing the turbine is only half the battle: the emissions monitoring path to data center power" (Data Center Dynamics).
bullets.reason: Physical power & cooling bottleneck driving HALO infrastructure capex. Also tracked: "Nvidia and SanDisk Bets Joined Bitcoin in a $1.76 Billion Liquidation Wave" (BeInCrypto).

bullets.title: Workforce & Macro Signal
bullets.text: "Euro-Area Wage Growth Edges up, Keeping ECB Options Open" (Briefs Finance) — with U.S. unemployment at 4.1% (2026-10-01).
bullets.reason: Wage or bargaining-power resilience supporting labor income share.
